required_receipt_fields.label: R2_OFF | R2_C0
required_receipt_fields.attempt_id: actual UUID of unique COMPLETED attempt
required_receipt_fields.native_ledger_sha256_at_qualification: actual ledger SHA at receipt creation; diagnostic only across later appends
required_receipt_fields.performance_scope: Accounting qualification only: poor DD/TOTAL/ES20 may remain financially qualified; no candidate/performance/full approval

freeze_field: previous_financial_qualifications: list[{label,path,sha256}] exactly prior required labels, no extras/duplicates
verifier: Pin each exact financial receipt file SHA from freeze; schema/decision/qualification/accounting_qualified and all mandatory financial_gates must be exact passing values; unknown or missing rejects.

Hash risk_analysis, completion_manifest, supervisor, ledger_snapshot against receipt. risk analysis must have accounting_qualified=true and qualification=VALID_ACCOUNTED_PREFIX; physical_binding fields must agree with receipt.

Find exactly one current ledger attempt by receipt UUID; require statusCOMPLETED, exact label/source, detail.report path+SHA and actual_returncode0; actual report file SHA must agree. Receipt native_ledger_path equals actual ledger path.

Find same exact COMPLETED attempt in immutable snapshot. Canonical completed_attempt_sha256 must agree with both current entry and snapshot entry. The ledger whole-file SHA at qualification is not required to match a later append-mutated ledger.
Actual report physical_prefix_attempt must agree UUID/label/source/ledger path; manifest and supervisor attempt/source/rc/COMPLETED bindings remain exact.
OFF no prior receipt; C0 OFF; A0 OFF+C0. Receipt filenames or COMPLETED alone never replace financial PASS. Root receipt created only after actual reader/evidence PASS.
